'''December 2000 Minneapolis tournament (12 December)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 12 December 2000. [[Robert Jeffery]] won it. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1543">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-13-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1543/ mirkwood-deadbody-style], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 13 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-13-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1543/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Robert Jeffery]]
